title: In png_set_tRNS of pngset.c, there is a possible memory corruption due to a use-after-free. (CVE-2026-58936)
description: CVE-2026-58936 is a use-after-free vulnerability in the png_set_tRNS function of pngset.c that may cause memory corruption. Exploitation could lead to remote code execution without requiring additional privileges or user interaction.
